recipe.visualDefinition: A surreal, high-angle composition featuring a small, rustic house with a red roof isolated on a tiny rocky outcrop in the middle of a vast, dark teal body of water. The scene is characterized by a gritty, high-contrast texture and a sense of lonely desolation, with subtle elements like floating currency and a shark fin breaking the surface.
coreVisualRelationships: The vibrant red of the house roof acts as the primary focal point against the cool teal water.
The house is centered vertically but slightly offset to the left, balanced by a dead tree on the right.
The dark, textured water occupies the majority of the frame, emphasizing the theme of isolation.
coreInvariants: A single house on a rocky island
Deep teal or turquoise water with heavy grain

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The house is the central subject, scaled to occupy approximately one-third of the vertical space, positioned in the middle ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red roof of the house provides the strongest visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the red roof, moves down to the rocky base, then outward to the floating currency in the water, and finally upward to the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space provided by the textured water surface surrounding the island.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep teal and dark blue-green water tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant terracotta red on the roof tiles.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale white/grey for the text and rocky foundation.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with low overall saturation, except for the localized red of the roof.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Wide, geometric sans-serif and fluid, lowercase script.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses wide tracking and a heavy, extended geometric structure.
Secondary text uses a thin, monolinear script with wide spacing between characters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script characters are separated by dots to create a rhythmic, horizontal line.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, heavy geometric sans and a delicate, airy script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric, industrial feel of the primary text.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Autography or a light signature script
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the thin, fluid, lowercase secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-angle photo of a small brown house with a bright red tiled roof on a tiny rocky island in the middle of a dark teal, choppy ocean. A dead, leafless tree stands next to the house. Submerged dollar bills float in the water. A shark fin is visible in the distance. The overall image has a heavy, gritty film grain and dark vignetting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in a wide, bold, white geometric sans-serif font at the top center with extreme letter spacing. Below it, add the secondary title in a thin, white, lowercase script font, with each letter separated by a dot and very wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the roof a distinct terracotta red?
Is the water a dark, textured teal?
Is the text tracking wide enough to span the width of the house?
Is the overall mood gritty and melancholic?

adjustableVariables: Depth of the teal water color
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and social media handles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the house looks integrated into the water environment.
Check that the grain texture doesn't obscure the text legibility.
Verify the red roof is the most saturated element in the frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central, isolated architectural subject with a contrasting color pop against a vast, textured, monochromatic environment, topped with wide-tracked, dual-style typography.
